The Jammu and Kashmir Police have arrested 14 people for allegedly attempting to facilitate cheating during the JKSSB Finance Assistants' examination. Police say candidates were provided with tiny microchips to receive answers transmitted by facilitators outside the examination centres. Eight wireless sets and 22 mobile phones have been seized. A Special Investigation Team is probing the case.
